title: VK Bridge event catalogue

DefaultUpdateConfigData.description: Default fields for config response on all platforms

lat.description: Geographic latitude of a point, specified in degrees (from -90 to 90).

lng.description: Geographic longitude of a point, specified in degrees (from -180 to 180).

of product information

The value of the string that will be displayed on the client when

for communities: "[club123|name]"

the corresponding objects

Date (`timestamp_ms` alternative) in format:
`yyyy:MM:dd HH:mm:ss`

text.description: Button text key (см. link_text в stories.getVideoUploadServer)

Clickable area border on the sticker. The points should be located
clockwise, forming a closed square.

relation_width.description:
The desired width of the sticker relative to the screen is (0, 1), the
height will be calculated taking into account maintaining the aspect ratio
of the content.

rotation.description: Rotation, from 0 to 359 deg. Counterclockwise rotation.

URL of the square user's photo with 200px width.
https://vk.ru/images/camera_200.png will be returned if the photo
is not set.

sex.description: User sex: 0 - not specified, 1 - female, 2 - male

bdate.description:
Date of Birth. It is returned in the format D.M.YYYY or D.M (if the
year of birth is hidden). If the date of birth is hidden entirely,
the field is not in the response.

bdate_visibility.description:
Visibility of Date of birth: 0 - hidden, 1 - entire date of birth is visible,
2 - day and month are visible

can_access_closed.description: Can see a private user profile

photo_100.description:
URL of the square user's photo with 100px width.
https://vk.ru/images/camera_100.png will be returned if the photo
is not set.

photo_200.description:
URL of the square user's photo with 200px width.
https://vk.ru/images/camera_200.png will be returned if the photo
is not set.

photo_max_orig.description:
URL of the square user's photo with maximum size.
https://vk.ru/images/camera_400.png will be returned if the photo
is not set.

close_comments.description:
`true` - post comments will be closed
`false` - permission to leave post comments will be up to user's settings (default)

copyright.description: Source of the post. Internal and external links supported

friends_only.description:
`true` - post will be available to friends only
`false` - post will be available to all users (default)

owner_id.description:
ID of the user or community on whose wall the post is to be
published

place_id.description: The place ID where the user is marked

publish_date.description: Publication date (in Unix time). If used, posting will be delayed until the set time

services.description:
List of services or websites the update will be exported to, if the user has so requested.
Sample values: 'twitter', 'facebook'

signed.description:
`true` - the post posted on behalf of the community will have a
signature added (the name of the user who posted the post)
`false` - the signature will not be added. The parameter is taken
into account only when publishing on the community wall and
specifying the from_group parameter. By default, the signature is
not added
